# KK Studio instructions

Read root AGENTS.md and AI_RULES.md, then docs/engineering/SDLC.md, docs/engineering/BRANCH-POLICY.md, docs/engineering/REVIEW.md and docs/engineering/PROMPTING.md plus current docs/governance/ sources before editing.
